sentinelConf:
port 26379
bind 10.0.0.3 127.0.0.1
daemonize no
dir /srv/valkey/sentinel
requirepass "pw"
sentinel announce-ip 10.0.0.3
sentinel announce-port 26379
sentinel sentinel-pass "pw"
sentinel monitor main 10.0.0.1 6379 2
sentinel auth-pass main "pw"
sentinel down-after-milliseconds main 5000
sentinel failover-timeout main 60000
sentinel parallel-syncs main 1
serverConf:
port 6379
bind * -::*
protected-mode yes
tcp-backlog 511
tcp-keepalive 300
daemonize no
loglevel notice
logfile ""
dir /srv/valkey/data
tls-port 25061
tls-cert-file /srv/valkey/tls/server.pem
tls-key-file /srv/valkey/tls/server.pem
tls-ca-cert-file /srv/valkey/tls/ca.crt
tls-auth-clients no
tls-protocols "TLSv1.2 TLSv1.3"
requirepass "pw"
masterauth "pw"
maxmemory-clients 10%
lazyfree-lazy-expire yes
lazyfree-lazy-server-del yes
lazyfree-lazy-user-del yes
lazyfree-lazy-user-flush yes
activedefrag yes
latency-monitor-threshold 100
save ""
appendonly no
io-threads 1
maxclients 65504
maxmemory 2867mb
replica-announce-ip 10.0.0.3
min-replicas-to-write 1
min-replicas-max-lag 10
replica-priority 0
replicaof 10.0.0.1 6379
